---
title: "Half-A aggregate screening: common retained sample"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

Run after section 10.1's TWFE-common-population computation. Only the guarded A-only prepared input and saved A-only fit caches are opened. New CSVs use the `common_screen_` prefix under `_output/analysis/output/3.1a/common_screen/`; prior results and the decision template are read-only.

```{r}
root<-normalizePath(getwd())
while(!file.exists(file.path(root,'_quarto.yml'))) {
  parent<-dirname(root);if(parent==root)stop('Repository not found');root<-parent
}
source(file.path(root,'R/heldout_common_screen.R'))
results<-run_aggregate_common_screen(root)
knitr::kable(results$common_screen_summary[missing_handling=='keep' | diagnostic=='unscreened',
  .(scenario,model,diagnostic,cutoff,rmse,relative_rmse,coverage,width,n_retained,excluded_share)],digits=3)
```
